name: io.github.Clawdio777/verity
description: Real-time fact-checking MCP. Verifies claims against live sources with structured verdicts.

environmentVariables.name: VERITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: VERITY API key (pg_...) from a card credit purchase at https://verity.basechainlabs.com/#get-access. Calls go to the hosted endpoint with this key in X-Api-Key and are charged to your credits. Used instead of VERITY_PRIVATE_KEY when both are set.

environmentVariables.name: VERITY_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base wallet private key (0x...) to pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, signed on your machine. Per-call: 0.10 USDC (verify), 0.50 USDC (deep-check), 0.75 USDC (batch). Set this or VERITY_API_KEY.
